encoding: ASCII TSV; literal tabs separate fields; LF terminates every record; no quoting or escapes; empty DNA is an empty field; dot denotes an unavailable score

geometry_recipe.serialization: prefix followed by TAB and each listed CASE field in order, followed by LF; SHA256 of ASCII bytes; integers are canonical unsigned decimal

semantics.coordinates: all spans half open; read and owned spans are native-parent coordinates; reference and core spans are genomic-forward; reference includes complete future guard; core is fixed independently of candidate length
semantics.geometry_ancestry: SHA256 of canonical sorted compact JSON bound in manifest, containing immutable native parent pin, initial_context/state, chunk, tensor pin and expanded timestep interval; excludes context-mode-specific frame and paths
semantics.reference_paths: REFPATH is a subset of PATH, projected from graph walks independently marked is_reference, with custody in manifest; never populated from truth fragments
semantics.event_coordinates: event_start and event_end are offsets in reference_window; the exact REF haplotype is its slice; archived_native_forward equals oriented(left_guard + native + right_guard without future_bases)
semantics.score: finite retained guarded log mass or dot; unscored candidate must be graph-only; graph-only is never historical inference eligible even if finite
semantics.duplicates: candidate sequence duplicates merge origin bits only when score presence and finite log mass are identical; conflicting duplicates reject; PATH duplicates deduplicate
semantics.baseline: exactly six roles per CASE; saved top-level choices and gates; numeric replay absolute tolerance 1e-11; sequence, gate, abstention exact
semantics.ordering: CASE precedes its PATH/CAND/BASE; TRUTH precedes its MASK/EVENT; all CASE records require unique case_id; truth has exactly the same case_id set
semantics.masks: zero or more sorted, disjoint MASK intervals per name; clipped by evaluator to fixed core; missing name means empty exposure
semantics.events: zero or more EVENT records; resolved=0 retains archive ambiguity and its nonempty reason; no allele call is made from an unresolved archive

cli.evaluate: context-atlas evaluate --cases FILE --cases-sha256 SHA --truth FILE --truth-sha256 SHA --output NEWDIR
